decisions.reason: Its quantified customer savings signal strong performance above aspiration, so a growing firm with slack and strong core fit is very unlikely to reallocate these resources away.
As a close-to-core machine still supported after launch and without visible signs of underperformance, it would likely stay on the market while management continues to learn from sales and use.
Because this flagship modular line is closely tied to the firm's strategic direction, management would keep it unless results clearly fell short of aspiration, which is not indicated.
This product has weaker external success signals than the more emphasized launches, but its proximity to the established offer and the firm's current growth make retention more likely than exit.
As a new 2024 multi-model shredder line close to the core business, it would usually be given more time under conditions of organizational slack unless early results were clearly disappointing.

Although somewhat more exploratory than the shredder line, it still builds on the firm's established capabilities and would likely be retained for another year while performance information accumulates.
